Article 344. Production, storage, import, transportation, distribution in the territory of republic Kazakhstan mass media and related products



1. production, storage, import, transportation in the territory of republic Kazakhstan the products of the media, which contains information and materials, directed toward propaganda or agitation of a forced displacement of the constitutional system, disturbance of the integrity of republic Kazakhstan, the undermining of the National Security, war, initiation social, racial, national, religious, class and ancestral dissension, cult of cruelty, violence and pornography, is punished by a fine, to  the physical persons in the size up to twenty, to officials, entrepreneurs - in the size of up to twenty five, on legal persons, that are the subjects of small to medium enterprise, - in the size of fifty to hundred, on legal persons, that are subjects of large enterprise, in the size of hundred to two hundred monthly salaries with the confiscation of the media products.



2. Distribution in the territory of republic of Kazakhstan, media products, which contains information and materials, directed toward propaganda or agitation of a forced displacement of the constitutional system, disturbance of the integrity of republic Kazakhstan, the undermining of the National Security, war, initiation of social, racial, national, religious, class and ancestral dissension, propaganda and the justification for extremism or terrorism, is punished by a fine, to  the physical persons in the size up to twenty, to officials, entrepreneurs - in the size of up to twenty five, on legal persons, that are the subjects of small to medium enterprise, - in the size of fifty to hundred, on legal persons, that are subjects of large enterprise, in the size of hundred to two hundred monthly salaries with the confiscation of the media products.



(...)



Article 363. The actions, provoking  violation of law in the conditions of the state of emergency 



Actions, provoking violation of law or initiating national and religious dissension, active preventing physical persons and by the officials from exercising their rights and responsibilities, as well as malicious insubordination to a legal order or demand of the employee of the ministry of interior,  national security, soldier, representatives of authority or community, that carry out official duties or public debt  of  protecting  social order, or the actions, disrupting social order and calmness of the physical persons, and also disturbing legislation about the administrative supervision, performed in the locality, where state of emergency is declared, is punished by a fine  in the size of up to ten monthly salaries or administrative arrest for the period of up to thirty days.



(...)



Article 375. The disturbance of legislation about the freedom of religion and religious associations

2. preventing the conduct of religious rites, other religious activity, performed in accordance with the law, violation of the rights of persons  on the account of their relation to the religion, the profanation of objects, structures or places, respected by the followers of one or other religion, the insult of religious feelings –



Are punished by a fine in the size to eight, and in case of public officials - in the size of fifteen,  monthly salaries
